title: Shannon Classic 4 Large Floor – Strong Plastic Versatile – Practical Organizer for Home and Office Storage AR
bullets: 4 ROLES with large storage capacity: provides convenient space to organize and separate different items and necessities.
Space-saving vertical design: it helps take up space better while providing multiple storage in one unit.
Sturdy plastic material: suitable for daily use and provides a practical unit for organizing various items in the home or office.
MULTI-FUNCTION: Suitable for organizing kitchen utensils, bathroom supplies, stationery and various household items.
EASY CONTENT ORGANIZATION: role dividing helps quickly reach items and keep place organized.
desc: Organize your stuff easily with the large Shannon Classic 4 tiers, designed to provide practical storage space that helps organize various essentials inside the home or office. It features a vertical 4-tier design, providing convenient space to easily divide and access items while making better use of space. Made of strong plastic material suitable for daily use, it can be used to organize kitchen utensils, bathroom supplies, stationery and various household items. The multi-tier design helps reduce clutter and arrange contents according to use, and fits in spaces where extra storage is needed. A practical and versatile option to organize your home or office and keep items tidy and accessible.
